The degree to which these profiles are accurate tends to increase with the number of data - points ( e.g. crime scenes ) that the profiler has to work with ( i.e. that are believed to be linked to the same offender ) . It is possible , however , that certain evidence may lead the profiler to suspect the criminal drives a certain type of vehicle .
